items.stem: A log shows 'Failed password for invalid user test from 203.0.113.9'. What does 'invalid user' tell you?
choices: The account name does not exist on the host

items.stem: Your rule counts failures since midnight with no window. What goes wrong at 23:50?
choices: A day's scattered typos can add up to an alert

items.stem: Five failures arrive at seconds 0, 59, 118, 177, 236 against a 4-in-60 s rule. Does it fire?
choices: No; no four fall within 60 seconds

items.stem: A rule has precision 0.9 and recall 0.2. Describe it.
choices: Alerts are trustworthy but most attacks are missed

items.stem: Doubling true negatives while holding other counts does what to precision?
Two files have SHA-256 digests that differ in the last character. What do you conclude?
Which of these is correctly defanged?
A user forwards a phish to the whole department 'as a warning'. What risk did that create?
choices: More people can now click the live link

items.stem: Which ATT&CK tactic describes the attacker's goal of staying in after a reboot?
A colleague says 'this T1566 alert proves a nation-state attack'. Your response?
choices: Technique use alone does not identify an actor

items.stem: Valid-account misuse is hard to detect mainly because…
A message's From domain is example.org, DKIM d=example.org passes, SPF fails. DMARC result?
Strict alignment would treat mail.harborpay.example vs harborpay.example how?
Why would an attacker register harb0rpay.example?
choices: To pass checks for a look-alike domain users misread

items.stem: A vector changes only AC:L to AC:H. What happens to the base score?
Two flaws both score 7.5. One is on a test VM, one on payroll. Which patch first?
An analyst rounds 6.94 to 6.9 when scoring CVSS by hand. What is the correct value?
Severity weight 3, criticality 2 versus weight 2, criticality 3. Which wins?
choices: They tie at 6; earlier arrival decides

items.stem: Your queue will breach three SLAs this hour. What is the honest action?
choices: Tell the shift lead and request help

items.stem: A single 6-hour detection appears among ten 10-minute ones. Which summary misleads less?
choices: The median with the outlier named
